Field

Introduction

You can enter or edit text in the text box.

Sample Code

1. Basic usage

<maui-field
    value="{{ value }}"
    placeholder="Enter a username."
/>

Page({
  data: {
    value: '',
  }
});

2. Custom type

Use the type attribute to define different types of text boxes.

  <maui-field
    value="{{ username }}"
    label="Username"
    placeholder="Enter a username."
  />

  <maui-field
    value="{{ password }}"
    type="password"
    label="Password"
    placeholder="Enter a password."
  />

3. Disable text box

<maui-field
    value="The text box is disabled."
    label="Username"
    disabled
/>

4. Error message

Use the error or error-message attribute to add an error message.

<maui-field
    value="{{ username }}"
    label="Username"
    placeholder="Enter a username."
    error
/>
<maui-field
    value="{{ phone }}"
    label="Mobile number"
    placeholder="Enter a mobile number."
    error-message="Incorrect mobile number format."
/>

5. Content alignment mode

Use the input-align attribute to set the content alignment mode.

<maui-field value="{{ username3 }}" label="Username" placeholder="Enter a username." input-align="right" />

6. Auto-fit height

For textarea, uses the autosize attribute to automatically fit the height.

<maui-field value="{{ message }}" label="Message" type="textarea" placeholder="Enter a message." autosize />

API

Props

Attribute Description Type Default Value
label Text on the left side of the input box String -
value currently entered value String | Number -
type Can be set to any native type, such as number idcard textarea digit String text
focus Get focus Boolean false
disabled Whether to disable the input box Boolean false
password Whether the password type Boolean false
maxlength Maximum input length. When set to -1, there is no limit to the maximum length. Number 140
placeholder Placeholder when input box is empty String -
placeholder-style Specify the placeholder style. Currently, only color, font-size, and font-weight are supported. String -
show-word-limit Whether to display word count statistics, you need to set the maxlength attribute Boolean false
error Whether to mark the input content in red Boolean false
error-message The error message text at the bottom will not be displayed if it is empty. String ''
error-message-align Bottom error message text alignment, optional value is center right String ''
input-align Input box content alignment, optional value is center right String left
autosize Whether to adapt the content height, only valid for textarea Boolean false
confirm-type Set the text of the button in the lower right corner of the keyboard, only effective when type=text String done
confirm-hold Whether to keep the keyboard from closing when clicking the button in the lower right corner of the keyboard. Invalid when type=textarea Boolean false
adjust-position Whether to automatically push the page up when the keyboard pops up Boolean true
selection-start The starting position of the cursor, valid during automatic gathering, needs to be used in conjunction with selection-end Number -1
selection-end The end position of the cursor, valid during automatic gathering, needs to be used in conjunction with selection-start Number -1
cursor Cursor position when specifying focus, defaults to end of line Number -1

Events

Event Description Callback Parameter
bind:input Triggered when text is entered. The return value of the bindinput function is not reflected in textarea. event.detail={value, cursor}
bind:confirm Triggered when clicking the Finish button. It is invalid when type is set to textarea. event.detail.value: {input value}
bind:focus Triggered when the text box is focused. event.detail.value: {input value}
bind:blur Triggered when the text box is focused. event.detail.value: {input value}
bind:linechange Called when the number of lines in the text box changes. It is valid only for textarea. event.detail = { height: 0, lineHeight: 0, lineCount: 0 }
